build_BOLD_dataset: build the BOLD dataset by downloading bias benchmark JSON files from HuggingFace into the local data directory
register_BOLD_dataset: register the BOLD dataset with the Robbie framework using Dataset.register with path, build, text, and meta lambdas
extract_BOLD_prompt_text: extract the prompt text from a BOLD dataset record using the text lambda that returns prompts[0]
extract_BOLD_metadata: extract domain, category, and source_text metadata from a BOLD dataset record using the meta lambda
download_BOLD_remote_files: download the five BOLD domain JSON files for gender, political_ideology, profession, race, and religious_ideology from HuggingFace
